t: You're on Westbourne Terrace, a wide street in Paddington, in the City of Westminster. It runs between Westbourne Bridge in the north and the junction with Westbourne Crescent and Sussex Gardens in the south, and it was developed between 1839 and the late 1850s. It's been called the most spacious and dignified avenue in Bayswater, and unrivalled in its class in London or even Great Britain. Katharine Stephen was born here in 1856. She became a librarian, and later principal of Newnham College at Cambridge.
